messages.subject: Gray Screen
parts:
My application is deployed and working.  However, the users have let me know that during their use, eventually the screen goes gray and they have to refresh.

Why is this happening?  If it is just timing out, is there a way to increase the time?  How can I prevent this?

Thanks,
Carrie

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Gray Screen
parts:
Carrie,

I am assuming you are talking about your application on shinyapps.io, right? In that case, and for future issues, you will be better off to post your questions to the following forum:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/shinyapps-users

Application connections time out after a certain period of inactivity. This is by default 15 minutes, but you can change that value in the shinyapps dashboard:

Application -> Settings -> Advanced -> Connection Timeout

If you or your users see a different behavior, then please provide more details about the issue: 
- Application URL
- How long application is up before it greys out


Best,
Fereshteh
